knownIssuesSource: registered-projects.json projects.yield-claim-nft.knownIssues (8 entries; knownIssuesSource=null, unfalsifiable cache - no KI suppression applied without verbatim coverage of root cause)

decisions.kiCheck: Partial-only vs KI#4 'Owner trust assumptions for registering dispatchers, setting prices, pausing, emergency withdraw': KI covers owner powers being trusted, not a zero-default cap that accrues an unbounded pot a third party captures. Non-obvious footgun (Law 3 exception) -> NOT suppressed. Memory 'externally-derived yield = opportunity cost' must NOT be applied (suppressionGuard ECON-005: AM redeemable to unbacked phUSD => dilution).
decisions.ledger: no match (no NFTBonfire entries; L-12 d9d8e16a04 is the same footgun family on another contract, different fingerprint)

decisions.kiCheck: No registry KI covers it. story-053 accepting front-runnability is a Law-2 statement, not a KI disposal; in-source NatSpec has no suppression authority. Cross-project analogue: phoenix-nft-staking M-01 521c20ad (wont-fix, 'MEV / first-claimer front-run of winner-take-all nudge pot', different contract BatchNFTMinterMultiToken.batchMint) - disclosed, not a match (different project/contract/fingerprint). Kept as Informational.

Partial-only vs KI#4 (owner trust for registering dispatchers): the hazard is a non-obvious consequence of a stale grant (NFTMigrator 0x22c0fc1a still an authorized minter, V1 NFTMinter unpaused) that becomes value-bearing only once NFTBonfire is wired -> footgun, NOT suppressed.
decisions.ledger: no match. Fingerprint 69453741 (NFTMinterV2.sol:mintFor:stale-authorized-minter) shares contract:function with L-04 674c799b2058 but rootCauseClass differs -> no collision (hashes differ). Searched ledger titles+full entries for migrator/V1/mintFor/authorized minter/0x22c0: only M-01 c43398d5 (fixed), M-02 49fb985f (fixed), Q-01 98c9fc45 (fixed) on deleted src/V2/NFTMigrator.sol (different roots: gas DoS / late-registration brick / ctor zero-address) and L-04 (open, pause bypass). NO wont-fix/acknowledged/false-positive entry re-raised -> no prior owner wont-fix to disclose. Not a regression of M-01/M-02 (different root cause).

decisions.kiCheck: Partial-only vs KI#5 'Pauser trust assumptions (designated pauser can pause/unpause)': KI trusts a designated pauser; this finding is that no pauser is designated at deploy. NOT suppressed.
decisions.ledger: facet (a) 'pausing NFTMinterV2 does not stop bonfire burns' = root cause of L-04 674c799b2058 (open; NFTMinterV2.burn privileged path ignores paused; NFTBonfire.burn calls nftMinter.burn at NFTBonfire.sol:106; NFTMinterV2.sol unchanged in range) -> reconciled as still-open L-04, NOT filed. Facet (b) 'NFTBonfire pauser defaults to address(0)' -> new (fingerprint 92648eec).

decisions.kiCheck: No KI match. Cross-project disclosure (memory: disclose when re-filing an owner wont-fix): it challenges the premise of phoenix-nft-staking H-01 858e9e80 (status wont-fix; title 'Value-blind nudge gate: full nudgePaymentToken pot paid on count-only gate regardless of value paid'). triageReason field is null; operator rationale lives in severityNote: '[2026-07-21, OPERATOR TRIAGE] WONT-FIX at HEAD c881a42. Severity at HEAD: Medium ... Re-closed against HEAD's premises, NOT the dead owner-driven premise: the residual value-blindness is accepted as a bounded operational property, not eliminated.' The 'NFT has no redemption value' basis is recorded in project memory. CORRECTION to dedup: 521c20ad (phoenix-nft-staking M-01) is status wont-fix, NOT open (severityNote: 'The 2026-06-09 owner acceptance of the race is UPHELD, not overridden - only its rationale is corrected.'). Neither entry is flipped; human must re-anchor.
decisions.ledger: no ycn match; routed per dedup to manual-review MR23-001 + phoenix-nft-staking triage note. Passed through (not suppressed) so it stays visible; finding-manager may elect not to open a ycn ledger entry per dedup routing - human decision.
